title: Aligning Institutional Power and Operational Ability
title_zh: 对齐制度性权力与运行能力

paragraphs.en: To be socially sustainable, Agentic AI systems require normative designs that align responsibilities with the ability to fulfil them. Identifying incongruences such as unsatisfiable expectations or privilege escalation is crucial in avoiding normative pitfalls. In this study, we discuss design dimensions suitable for describing multi-agent systems in light of this norm-ability alignment requirement. We propose a formal framework centred on process-oriented modelling and institutional power for the analysis of a given normatively relevant process, discuss strategies for repairing it, and elaborate on how the symmetrical relation between operational process and institutional state affects the lifecycle of normative positions.
paragraphs.zh: 要实现社会可持续性，智能体式AI系统需要规范性设计，使责任与履行责任的能力相一致。 识别诸如无法满足的期望或权限提升等不一致现象，对于避免规范性陷阱至关重要。 在本研究中，我们围绕这一规范—能力对齐要求，讨论适用于描述多智能体系统的设计维度。 我们提出一个以面向过程的建模和制度权力为核心的形式化框架，用于分析给定的具有规范相关性的过程，讨论修复该过程的策略，并详细阐述操作过程与制度状态之间的对称关系如何影响规范地位的生命周期。

paragraphs.en: Social systems come with social expectations and responsibilities ascribed to the participating actors. However, if we do not align those with the concrete ability to perform the actions required by those expectations, we enter into an incongruent state of affairs that might render somebody else’s rights vacuous – or better, their exercise frustrated – even without incurring any explicit norm-violation. For instance, if an individual is legally granted freedom of movement in a building while barriers prevent them from ever leaving the facility, their right is formally acknowledged yet materially nullified. Previous work, such as [ 30 ] , started investigating the interaction between deontic and potestative concepts, showing how an instrumental interpretation of the latter towards the former can reveal gaps in institutional design, while distinguishing the two concepts as belonging to two distinct ontological categories.
paragraphs.zh: 社会系统伴随着归于参与行为主体的社会期望与责任。 然而，如果这些期望与履行这些期望所需行动的具体能力不一致，我们就会陷入一种不协调的状态，可能使他人的权利变得空洞——或者说更确切地说，其行使受到挫折——甚至不会产生任何明显的违规行为。 例如，如果一个人在法律上被赋予在一栋建筑内自由行动的权利，而障碍物却使其永远无法离开该设施，那么其权利在形式上得到承认，却在实质上被取消。 先前的工作，例如 [ 30 ] ，已开始研究义务性概念与权能性概念之间的相互作用，展示了以后者作为前者工具的解读方式如何揭示制度设计中的缺口，同时区分这两个概念，认为它们属于两个不同的本体论范畴。

paragraphs.en: In the context of artificial multi-agent systems, including those currently described as Agentic AI, such incongruence may hinder their controllability. This issue can become apparent even in localised settings, as suggested by the diverging industrial approaches to software development-oriented agentic harnesses such as Claude Code [ 1 ] , Codex [ 21 ] , or Pi [ 7 ] . As highlighted by recent episodes like the OpenAI incident involving the Hugging Face platform in July 2026 [ 22 , 13 ] , agents authorised to use tools for a task may exploit sequences of operational effects to gain access beyond the boundaries intended by system designers. Conversely, assigning tasks to harnessed agents that do not have access to the required operational machinery ( e.g. , Model Context Protocol (MCP) connections) could result in ineffective orchestration at best, and mission-critical failure at worst. In the interest of designing systems that outline a clear liability structure and support socially sustainable governance of agentic artificial intelligence, it is crucial that we avoid such normative pitfalls.
paragraphs.zh: 在人工多智能体系统的背景下，包括目前被描述为智能体人工智能（Agentic AI）的系统，这种不一致性可能会阻碍其可控制性。 即使在局部场景中，这个问题也可能变得明显，正如软件开发导向的智能体框架（如 Claude Code [ 1 ] 、Codex [ 21 ] 或 Pi [ 7 ] ）在工业界采取的不同路线所表明的那样。 正如 2026 年 7 月 OpenAI 涉及 Hugging Face 平台的事件 [ 22 , 13 ] 等近期案例所凸显的，被授权为某项任务使用工具的智能体可能会利用一系列操作效果来获取超出系统设计者预期边界的访问权限。 相反，将任务分配给无法访问所需操作机制（例如，模型上下文协议（MCP）连接）的智能体，轻则导致编排无效，重则造成关键任务失败。 为了设计出能够明确责任结构并支持智能体人工智能在社会层面可持续治理的系统，我们必须避免这类规范性陷阱。

paragraphs.en: Although historically many computational normative frameworks have remained primarily deontic-centric , several explicitly represent institutional power alongside obligations and permissions, including [ 2 , 6 , 32 , 33 ] . Especially in computational settings, operational ability becomes a precondition for sound attribution of institutional power and deontic positions alike; that is, powers and duties become highly problematic in a world where their corresponding actions cannot be performed [ 31 ] . In this context, we observe that tracing institutional side-effects remains difficult as long as the operational layer lacks an adequate process model-oriented execution semantics. The main function of this formalism would be to capture action-dependence (see e.g. [ 5 ] ) in workflows. Moreover, we argue for treating power as an independent normative category in its institutional, constitutively-ascribed form [ 10 , 14 ] and “instrumental” but ontologically distinct interpretation i.e. , to maintain or update the state of normative systems [ 30 ] . Failing to do so hinders the ability to identify some undesirable configurations such as lingering powers and unsatisfiable obligations (see section 4 ). Such misalignments may give rise to disputes requiring judicial intervention ex-post , motivating their identification and prevention at design time.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管从历史上看，许多计算规范性框架主要以义务为中心，但也有若干框架在表示义务与许可的同时显式地表示了制度性权力，包括 [ 2 , 6 , 32 , 33 ]。 尤其是在计算环境中，操作能力成为对制度性权力与义务性地位进行合理归属的前提条件；也就是说，在其对应动作无法被执行的世界中，权力与义务将变得极成问题 [ 31 ]。 在此背景下，我们观察到，只要操作层缺乏面向过程模型的充分执行语义，追踪制度性副作用就仍然很困难。 这种形式化方法的主要功能是刻画工作流中的动作依赖性（参见例如 [ 5 ]）。 此外，我们主张将权力视为一个独立的规范范畴，既包括其制度性的、构成性地被赋予的形式 [ 10 , 14 ]，也包括“工具性”但在本体论上有区别的解释，即维护或更新规范系统的状态 [ 30 ]。 若不这样做，将妨碍识别某些不良配置的能力，例如持续残留的权力和无法满足的义务（见第 4 节）。 这类不一致可能引发需要事后司法干预的争议，因此在设计阶段对其加以识别和预防是很有必要的。

paragraphs.en: Throughout this paper, we use the following running example: an owner O O consigns goods to a broker B B , contractually empowered to sell them on O O ’s behalf; O O may terminate the consignment, and a creditor C C of B B may, upon B B ’s insolvency, seize the goods . The scenario is loosely inspired by a real consignment dispute [ 16 ] over a Star Wars Lego collection entrusted to a franchise that later changed hands, with the consignor alleging that neither payment nor the goods were returned. It is a simplification to illustrate our model, as we assume the consigned goods fall into B B ’s estate on insolvency, and that B B ’s mandate to sell lapses on insolvency. It is not within our scope to model real consignment law here. The consigned goods represent a contested resource, preconditioning normative actions and enabling operational continuation of the process in alternative directions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们始终使用以下运行示例：委托人 O 将货物委托给经纪人 B，B 在合同上被授权代表 O 出售这些货物；O 可以终止该委托，而 B 的债权人 C 则可以在 B 破产时扣押该货物。 该场景大致取材于一场真实的寄售纠纷[16]，该纠纷涉及一批交由一家特许经营商保管的星球大战乐高藏品，而该特许经营商随后易主，委托人称既未收到付款，货物也未被返还。 为说明我们的模型，这里做了简化：我们假设寄售货物在 B 破产时归入 B 的财产，并且 B 的销售授权在破产时失效。 对真实的寄售法进行建模不在我们的讨论范围之内。 寄售货物代表一种有争议的资源，为规范性行动提供了前提条件，并使流程能够朝替代方向继续运行。

paragraphs.en: To address the aforementioned issues, in this paper we expand on our previous work on the operational interpretation of power [ 18 ] and present the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 为解决上述问题，本文在我们之前关于幂的操作性解释的工作[18]的基础上进一步展开，并提出以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We propose a model that formalises the relation between the operational and institutional layers in terms of process execution, relating normative positions to agentic abilities in said process (section 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出一个模型，从过程执行的角度形式化操作层与制度层之间的关系，将规范性地位与该过程中的智能体能力相关联（第3节）。

paragraphs.en: Based on the proposed model, we define desirable properties of processes within normative systems that depend on both structural control-flow features and policy specification, namely, operational groundedness , formal institutional legitimacy , and power-ability alignment (section 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基于所提出的模型，我们定义了规范系统中过程应具备的理想性质，这些性质同时依赖于结构化控制流特征与策略规范，即：操作有据性、形式制度合法性与权力-能力一致性（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that the proposed model can capture incongruent institutional states that emerge from the relation between the two layers. In this sense, it represents an analytical tool to guide computational normative system design.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明所提出的模型能够捕捉由两个层之间的关系产生的制度不一致状态。 从这个意义上说，它代表了一种可用于指导计算性规范系统设计的分析工具。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish operational power from institutional power and refer to the former as (operational) ability in what follows, reserving power for institutional power. Ability is what an agent can physically bring about in its environment [ 18 ] . Institutional power is the capacity, conferred by a social or legal framework, to change institutional facts by acting [ 14 ] . Power resides on the potestative corner of Hohfeld’s analysis of normative systems (power-liability), distinct from the deontic corner (duty-right) [ 11 ] . In this sense, power is constitutively connected to the performance of an act producing an institutional effect in a context. A power in itself is conferred constitutively by means of another power [ 14 , 10 , 4 ] . Institutional power has been formalised in detail, both in logical and legal terms (see e.g. , [ 23 , 19 , 8 ] ). However, actively developed computational normative multi-agent frameworks remain deontic-centric , see e.g. , NPL [ 12 ] and its extensions [ 39 ] , leaving potestative power underserved. Moreover, while domain-specific languages (DSLs) for norm specification such as InstAL [ 6 ] and eFLINT [ 34 , 33 ] explicitly support the synchronisation of the operational and institutional layers ( i.e. , via counts-as events and the sync primitive), the relation between deontic positions and operationalised powers remains implicit instead of being modelled independently.

paragraphs.en: The lifecycle of Business Process Management (BPM) in organisational settings generally applies model-driven approaches to process design and implementation [ 15 ] . Petri nets have traditionally been utilised for the design and structural analysis of control flow in processes, mainly thanks to their intuitive mapping to distributed processes, and to their soundness properties [ 37 , 38 ] . The line extends to interactions between organisations in inter-organizational workflow nets [ 36 ] , operating-guideline “contracts” characterising correct partners [ 17 , 20 ] , and conformance of observed behaviour to a model [ 35 ] . Crucially, extracting Petri nets with process mining techniques proved effective for compliance checking by evaluating event logs ( i.e. , full execution traces) against normatively qualified patterns [ 26 ] . Finally, methodological contributions relating normative enforcement and monitoring to process models, especially in business settings in the form of Business Process Modelling Notation (BPMN), have outlined a formal framing for process-oriented governance [ 9 , 27 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 业务流程管理（BPM）在组织环境中的生命周期通常采用模型驱动的方法进行流程设计与实现 [ 15 ] 。 Petri 网传统上被用于流程中控制流的设计与结构分析，主要归功于其与分布式流程的直观映射关系，以及其可靠性（soundness）性质 [ 37 , 38 ] 。 这条脉络延伸至组织间交互的跨组织工作流网 [ 36 ] 、刻画正确合作方的操作指南（operating-guideline）“契约” [ 17 , 20 ] ，以及观测到的行为与模型之间的一致性（conformance） [ 35 ] 。 至关重要的是，利用流程挖掘技术提取 Petri 网，通过将事件日志（即完整的执行轨迹）与规范性质的模式进行比对评估，已被证明对合规性检查行之有效 [ 26 ] 。 最后，将规范执行与监控和流程模型（尤其是以业务流程建模表示法（BPMN）形式出现的业务场景中的流程模型）相关联的方法论贡献，已为面向流程的治理勾勒出一个形式化的框架 [ 9 , 27 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In this section we introduce the definitions with which we characterise multi-agent process execution at the operational and institutional level.

paragraphs.en: For modelling the occurrence of events at the operational ( i.e. , physical) level of a system which might cause institutional effects, we will rely on Petri net notation. paragraphs.en: A policy is here defined as a finite set of reactive rules meant to update the institutional state on the basis of action events. For simplicity, we assume a global institutional state and a conflict-resolved aggregate policy Π \Pi . Firing t t updates I I by applying every lifecycle event triggered by 𝖾𝗑𝖾𝖼 ⁡ ( a , t ) \mathsf{exec}(a,t) , i.e. , I ← upd ⁡ ( I , t ) I\leftarrow\mathrm{upd}(I,t) where upd ⁡ ( I , t ) = ( I ∖ 𝐷𝑒𝑎𝑐𝑡 ⁡ ( t ) ) ∪ 𝐴𝑐𝑡 ⁡ ( t ) \mathrm{upd}(I,t)=(I\setminus\mathit{Deact}(t))\;\cup\;\mathit{Act}(t) . The initial institutional state I 0 I_{0} is 𝐴𝑐𝑡 ⁡ ( ⊥ ) \mathit{Act}(\bot) . This formalisation of power is constitutive (after [ 10 , 14 ] ): executing t t brings about the institutional lifecycle events its policy prescribes, so power is conferred within Π \Pi in synchronisation with physical actions, not just defined operationally. Here, the prescribed lifecycle updates occur irrespective of the acting agent’s empowerment; power is used to assess formal institutional legitimacy (see Def. 9 ). paragraphs.en: Crucially, the concurrency expressed by the process model ( i.e. , instruct , bankrupt and terminate are concurrent transitions fired by autonomous agents in no fixed order) entails that the misalignment is carried not by any single act but by the sequence in which they occur. paragraphs.zh: 至关重要的是，进程模型所表达的并发性（即 instruct、bankrupt 和 terminate 是由自主智能体以无固定顺序触发的并发变迁）意味着失调并非由任何单一行为承载，而是由这些行为发生的顺序承载。 我们的框架通过受治理的可达性使这种依赖关系显式化；对于有界的操作网和有限多的规范立场，所产生的状态空间是有限的。 此外，仅凭道义框架无法捕捉本文所呈现的不同种类的失调。 让操作语义与制度语义在进程上保持分离，并允许规范立场与标记相矛盾，从而暴露出不一致的配置，例如变得空洞的立场连同导致它们的设计缺陷，这些在智能体出现任何不当行为之前就已存在。

paragraphs.en: The main goal of our proposed framework is to support the analysis and specification of normative designs for traceable and controllable computational systems. A process-centred modelling approach to the representation of the operational layer in normative scenarios, in the style of [ 29 ] , has been only partially explored in previous work. Governatori and Rotolo [ 9 ] present a formal approach to deontic policy specification on Business Process Modelling Notation (BPMN), but do not model its relation to potestative power i.e. , power as a stateful object bound to operational transitions. Ramezani et al. [ 26 ] also leverage process modelling formalism in combination with event log analysis to introduce trace-based compliance checking in a purely deontic sense; as such, their contribution only tackles ex-post analysis of historical execution. In contrast, our solution specifically targets strategies for evaluating a system before or during its deployment. InstAL [ 6 ] explicitly models institutional power and binds it to an event-based transition system. Similarly, contract-oriented frameworks such as Symboleo [ 28 ] do represent potestative positions and their institutional effects. However, these frameworks lack a process-centred representation that relates institutional powers to independently modelled operational abilities and characterises their alignment throughout execution over consumable resources. Mapping the normative lifecycle to these operational primitives allows us to expand on the traditional separation of [ 2 ] by grounding institutional positions onto a process state space. In this context, it is important to remark that our definition of operational groundedness (see Def. 8 ) only expresses possible future exercise, not guaranteed fulfilment or an agent’s ability to ensure it. Stochastic Petri-net semantics [ 3 ] could support quantitative analysis of the likelihood or timing of future exercise. However, relating such measures to agentive reliability as explored in [ 18 ] remains future work. Finally, none of the aforementioned contributions addresses the characterisation of alignment between operational and institutional layers. The present work offers a mathematically grounded framing for the desirable and undesirable normative states reachable within a given design, and for identifying and tracing misalignments and reasoning about repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出的框架的主要目标是支持和规范针对可追溯、可控的计算系统的规范性设计的分析与规约。 一种以 [ 29 ] 的风格、面向规范性场景中表示操作层的过程中心建模方法，在此前的工作中仅得到部分探索。 Governatori 和 Rotolo [ 9 ] 提出了一种在业务流程建模表示法（BPMN）上进行义务性策略规约的形式化方法，但并未建模其与权能性权力（potestative power）的关系，即与绑定到操作迁移上的有状态对象的那种权力的关系。Ramezani 等人 [ 26 ] 同样利用过程建模形式化方法结合事件日志分析，以纯义务性的意义引入基于轨迹的合规性检查；因此，他们的工作仅处理对历史执行的事后分析。 与之相对，我们的方案明确针对在系统部署之前或部署期间对其进行评估的策略。 InstAL [ 6 ] 显式地建模制度性权力，并将其绑定到基于事件的迁移系统上。 类似地，诸如 Symboleo [ 28 ] 之类的面向合同的框架确实表示了权能性位置及其制度性效果。 然而，这些框架缺乏一种过程中心的表示，无法将制度性权力与独立建模的操作能力相关联，并在消耗性资源上的整个执行过程中刻画二者的一致性。 将规范性生命周期映射到这些操作原语上，使我们能够通过将制度性位置落实到过程状态空间中，来扩展 [ 2 ] 中传统的划分方式。 在此背景下，需要着重指出的是，我们对操作落地性（operational groundedness）的定义（见定义 8）仅表示未来可能的行使，而不保证实现，也不表示智能体确保其实现的能力。 随机 Petri 网语义 [ 3 ] 可以支持对未来行使的可能性或时机的定量分析。 然而，将这些度量与 [ 18 ] 中探讨的智能体可靠性相关联，仍有待未来的工作。 最后，上述所有工作都没有涉及操作层与制度层之间一致性的刻画。 本工作为在给定设计中可达到的合意与不合意规范状态，以及为识别和追踪不一致并推理修复方案，提供了有坚实数学基础的框架。

sents.en: [ 26 ] also leverage process modelling formalism in combination with event log analysis to introduce trace-based compliance checking in a purely deontic sense; as such, their contribution only tackles ex-post analysis of historical execution.
sents.zh: [ 26 ] 同样利用过程建模形式化方法结合事件日志分析，以纯义务性的意义引入基于轨迹的合规性检查；因此，他们的工作仅处理对历史执行的事后分析。

sents.en: In contrast, our solution specifically targets strategies for evaluating a system before or during its deployment.
sents.zh: 与之相对，我们的方案明确针对在系统部署之前或部署期间对其进行评估的策略。

sents.en: InstAL [ 6 ] explicitly models institutional power and binds it to an event-based transition system.
sents.zh: InstAL [ 6 ] 显式地建模制度性权力，并将其绑定到基于事件的迁移系统上。

sents.en: Similarly, contract-oriented frameworks such as Symboleo [ 28 ] do represent potestative positions and their institutional effects.
sents.zh: 类似地，诸如 Symboleo [ 28 ] 之类的面向合同的框架确实表示了权能性位置及其制度性效果。

sents.en: However, these frameworks lack a process-centred representation that relates institutional powers to independently modelled operational abilities and characterises their alignment throughout execution over consumable resources.
sents.zh: 然而，这些框架缺乏一种过程中心的表示，无法将制度性权力与独立建模的操作能力相关联，并在消耗性资源上的整个执行过程中刻画二者的一致性。

sents.en: Mapping the normative lifecycle to these operational primitives allows us to expand on the traditional separation of [ 2 ] by grounding institutional positions onto a process state space.
sents.zh: 将规范性生命周期映射到这些操作原语上，使我们能够通过将制度性位置落实到过程状态空间中，来扩展 [ 2 ] 中传统的划分方式。

sents.en: In this context, it is important to remark that our definition of operational groundedness (see Def. 8 ) only expresses possible future exercise, not guaranteed fulfilment or an agent’s ability to ensure it.
sents.zh: 在此背景下，需要着重指出的是，我们对操作落地性（operational groundedness）的定义（见定义 8）仅表示未来可能的行使，而不保证实现，也不表示智能体确保其实现的能力。

sents.en: Stochastic Petri-net semantics [ 3 ] could support quantitative analysis of the likelihood or timing of future exercise.
sents.zh: 随机 Petri 网语义 [ 3 ] 可以支持对未来行使的可能性或时机的定量分析。

sents.en: However, relating such measures to agentive reliability as explored in [ 18 ] remains future work.
sents.zh: 然而，将这些度量与 [ 18 ] 中探讨的智能体可靠性相关联，仍有待未来的工作。

sents.en: Finally, none of the aforementioned contributions addresses the characterisation of alignment between operational and institutional layers.
sents.zh: 最后，上述所有工作都没有涉及操作层与制度层之间一致性的刻画。

sents.en: The present work offers a mathematically grounded framing for the desirable and undesirable normative states reachable within a given design, and for identifying and tracing misalignments and reasoning about repairs.
sents.zh: 本工作为在给定设计中可达到的合意与不合意规范状态，以及为识别和追踪不一致并推理修复方案，提供了有坚实数学基础的框架。

paragraphs.en: Developing efficient verification procedures and synthesising repairs that preserve the intended process outcomes remain directions for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 开发高效的验证程序以及合成能够保留预期流程结果的修复方案，仍是未来工作的方向。

paragraphs.en: In this study, we present a formal framework apt to represent operational and institutional states to aid normative system design. We reduce operational ability to process modelling primitives in order to leverage their concurrent and traceable execution semantics. Based on this stateful representation of the operational layer, we discuss its relation to the lifecycle of normative positions at the institutional level and present desirable properties that characterise design-level alignment between the two. Then, taking inspiration from a reported consignment dispute, we show through a stylised scenario how such a process-oriented representation can support the ex-ante detection of undesirable normative configurations emerging from the system design. The framework distinguishes positions whose exercise has become operationally impossible from enabled actions unsupported by institutional power, making both kinds of misalignment explicit over reachable configurations. We position our solution against the related work in computational settings, by observing how no previous contribution studies the grounding of institutional state onto resource-constrained process execution. Finally, we discuss future directions leading to the automated detection and eventual repair of misaligned configurations in normative designs.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们提出一个能够表示运行层与制度层状态的形式化框架，以辅助规范系统的设计。 我们将运行层能力约化为过程建模原语，以便利用其并发且可追溯的执行语义。 基于这一对运行层的状态化表示，我们讨论其与制度层规范立场生命周期的关系，并提出刻画二者在设计层面保持一致性的若干理想性质。 然后，受一宗已报道的寄售纠纷启发，我们通过一个风格化的场景展示这种面向过程的表示如何支持在事前检测出源自系统设计的不良规范配置。 该框架能够区分那些其行使在运行上已不可能的立场与缺乏制度权力支持的已启用动作，从而在可达配置上显式呈现这两类错位。 我们将本方案与计算领域的相关工作进行对比，指出此前没有研究探讨制度状态在资源受限过程执行上的落地问题。 最后，我们讨论未来的研究方向，包括在规范设计中自动检测并最终修复错位的配置。
